summary: Comprehensive testing of Calorie Target feature in AI Weekly Meal Plan Generator. Backend API /api/weekly-plan/generate correctly accepts calorie_target parameter and generates meals with proper calorie distribution (25% breakfast, 35% lunch, 40% dinner). Frontend AIMealPlanGenerator component displays 4 calorie preset buttons (Weight Loss 1500, Maintenance 2000, Active 2500, Muscle Gain 3000), custom calorie input, and Enable checkbox. All features working correctly.

issues: Meal names with calorie counts are truncated in calendar view - calorie counts not visible without hover/click. This is expected for compact view but could be improved with tooltip on hover.

critical_code_review_comments: CALORIE_PRESETS array in AIMealPlanGenerator.js correctly defines 4 presets with label, calories, description, and color

ai_meal_planner.py calculates calorie distribution: breakfast_cal = int(calorie_target * 0.25), lunch_cal = int(calorie_target * 0.35), dinner_cal = int(calorie_target * 0.40)
AI prompt includes CALORIE REQUIREMENTS section with strict distribution rules
Frontend sends calorie_target: enableCalorieTarget ? calorieTarget : null in API request
data-testid attributes present for all calorie-related UI elements

context_for_next_testing_agent: Calorie Target feature fully tested and working. Backend /api/weekly-plan/generate accepts calorie_target parameter (integer, optional). When provided, AI generates meals with calorie counts in parentheses e.g. 'Greek Yogurt Parfait (~350cal)'. Distribution is breakfast 25%, lunch 35%, dinner 40%. Frontend AIMealPlanGenerator shows Enable checkbox, 4 preset buttons (1500/2000/2500/3000), and custom input. Route to Planner page is /planner.
